decks.notes: The primary focus of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's mana base through cards like Blood Moon and Sundering Eruption while deploying aggressive threats like Pyrogoyf and Broadside Bombardiers. The deck aims to quickly close out games by overwhelming the opponent with powerful creatures and spells, leveraging the mana acceleration provided by Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide. With a focus on creating an early advantage and maintaining pressure on the opponent, this Aggro Dragon Stompy deck aims to dictate the pace of the game and secure victory before the opponent can stabilize.

This Death & Taxes deck focuses on aggressive plays and disrupting the opponent's game plan by utilizing creature control and mana denial strategies. The deck's strength lies in its ability to efficiently deploy threats while disrupting the opponent's resources, ultimately overwhelming them with a combination of aggression and disruption. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional flexibility and card advantage, giving the deck an extra edge in longer games. With a solid mix of creatures, removal, and disruptive elements, this deck aims to quickly outpace and outmaneuver its opponents in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Troll of Khazad-dûm and Archon of Cruelty using cards like Entomb and Reanimate. By utilizing reanimation spells and control elements like Force of Will and Daze, the deck aims to cheat high-cost creatures into play early and overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Wasteland and Brazen Borrower to slow down the opponent's game plan while maintaining card advantage with cards like Brainstorm and Ponder.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Brainstorm, then bringing them back into play with Reanimate and Animate Dead. The key strategy is to use efficient card draw and disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with strong creatures like Troll of Khazad-dûm and Archon of Cruelty while also having answers to threats with Fatal Push and Brazen Borrower. The mana base is streamlined to support the combo strategy and ensure consistency.

The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo of Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor to mill the entire library, then use Dread Return to reanimate Thassa's Oracle for an instant win. The deck includes disruption in the form of Force of Will and Prismatic Ending, as well as card selection with Ponder and Brainstorm. Urza's Saga provides additional utility and finds key pieces of the combo. The mana base includes fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistency in casting spells. The deck is focused on efficiently executing the combo while interacting with the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with Eldrazi lands and fast mana sources like Ancient Tomb and Lotus Petal, allowing for aggressive plays like casting Thought-Knot Seer and other Eldrazi creatures early on. Chalice of the Void is used to disrupt opponents' strategies while cards like Glaring Fleshraker and Devourer of Destiny provide powerful threats on the board. The deck also utilizes disruptive lands like Wasteland and Cavern of Souls to control the field and protect its creatures, creating a fast-paced, aggressive strategy to overwhelm opponents.

The main focus of this deck is to generate a large amount of mana quickly through artifacts such as Voltaic Key, Basalt Monolith, and Grim Monolith. Mystic Forge is used to cast spells from the top of the library, enabling various combos with cards like Paradox Engine and Manifold Key. Karn, the Great Creator acts as both disruption and tutor for artifacts. The One Ring provides additional mana acceleration. Urza's Saga and Urza's Workshop help to assemble the artifact pieces needed for the win condition. Vexing Bauble and Kozilek's Command provide additional utility and control options.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly get powerful creatures into the graveyard, and then cheat them into play using cards like Entomb and Reanimate. By utilizing the combo of reanimation spells and powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its big threats early in the game. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy. With the right sequence of cards, this deck can quickly swing the game in its favor with big, game-ending threats.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill your graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Brainstorm, then bring them back onto the battlefield using Reanimate and Animate Dead. This combo strategy allows you to overwhelm your opponent with high-impact creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. Utilizing control elements like Force of Will and Thoughtseize, along with disruption like Wasteland and Fatal Push, this deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while executing its own powerful reanimation strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly establish a board presence and disrupt the opponent's strategy through aggro tactics. By utilizing cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Swords to Plowshares to search for and answer threats, as well as creatures like Knight of the Reliquary and Gaddock Teeg to apply pressure, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with efficient creatures and disruptive plays. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Fiend Artisan and Once Upon a Time provide additional flexibility and consistency to the deck's game plan.

This deck revolves around the combo card Doomsday, which allows the player to stack their deck in a specific order to win the game. By combining fast mana cards like Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual with card draw spells like Brainstorm and Ponder, the player can set up a winning sequence with Thassa's Oracle or a lethal Tendrils of Agony. Utilizing cards like Vexing Bauble and Personal Tutor, the player can manipulate their library effectively and win the game in just a few turns. This deck focuses on speed and precision to execute its win condition efficiently.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Reanimate, and then bringing them back onto the battlefield with Animate Dead. The key strategy is to outpace the opponent by reanimating large threats like Archon of Cruelty or Atraxa, Grand Unifier early in the game, overwhelming them before they have a chance to respond. The deck also includes disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo pieces and ensure its success.

This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures, then bringing them back into play with cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. It utilizes cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize to set up the combo and disrupt the opponent, while also packing plenty of disruption in the form of counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. By efficiently reanimating creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats before they can respond effectively. The mana base includes key lands like Underground Sea and Wasteland to support this strategy.

This deck focuses on disrupting opponents' strategies with a combination of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize, countermagic like Force of Will, and cheap removal spells like Fatal Push. It also utilizes creatures like Brazen Borrower and Nethergoyf to apply pressure on opponents while controlling the board. The deck aims to maintain tempo by efficiently utilizing cards like Daze and Brainstorm to stay ahead of the opponent. The mana base includes dual lands and fetch lands to ensure consistent mana access for the deck's spells.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt your opponent's strategy while applying pressure with evasive creatures. The deck aims to control the tempo of the game by using disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will, along with efficient removal like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat. The deck utilizes cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to dig for key pieces and maintain card advantage. The creatures in the deck, such as Nethergoyf and Brazen Borrower, are backed up by counter magic and removal to ensure they can connect with the opponent and close out the game quickly.

The main focus of this Mono Black Aggro deck is to aggressively disrupt the opponent's hand while applying pressure with efficient creatures. It aims to control the game through discard spells like Hymn to Tourach and Thoughtseize, along with removal spells like Fatal Push. The deck also includes disruptive creatures like Dauthi Voidwalker and efficient beaters like Nethergoyf and Barrowgoyf. With a mix of disruption, removal, and powerful creatures, this deck aims to put its opponent on the back foot and secure a quick victory.
